items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: John Orbishow. Oh, yeah. That's what Vic had.

ctx.x: Black Benny on drum. Black Benny on drum. Yeah.

John Orbishow. Oh, yeah. That's what Vic had. Piku, did he have Piku? Piku was playing, uh, Piku and, uh, uh, Kimball. Kimball on trumpet. And his wife was on the piano. Kimball on the piano, that's right. Piano.
So he was playing there, Vic Gaffert was playing there when you were taking lessons from him? When I was taking lessons from him. Did you ever go down here and play?
